description: Interior LiDAR scan of a storage tank, shell and roof passes, voxel-thinned to 2 cm.
layout: Block A: N x 3 int16 little-endian, interleaved x,y,z per point (bytes 0 .. N*6-1). Block B: N uint8 intensity (bytes N*6 .. N*7-1). No header.
intensity_decode: 0-255, LiDAR return intensity stretched between the 2nd and 98th percentile of each flight
frame: Tank model frame, same as tank.glb: X = plant north, Y = up, Z = plant east, metres; origin on the shell axis at the bottom-plate underside (datum)
three_js: const buf=await (await fetch('cloud.bin')).arrayBuffer(); const N=280000; const q=new Int16Array(buf,0,N*3); const pos=new Float32Array(N*3); for(let k=0;k<N*3;k++) pos[k]=q[k]*0.001; const inten=new Uint8Array(buf,N*6,N); // geometry.setAttribute('position',new THREE.BufferAttribute(pos,3))
